prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve and style-transfer.
Asset: one transparent player avatar in the established cozy Ukrainian board-game painted cat portrait series.
Input images: Image 1 is the ONLY human identity, face, expression, hair, beard and clothing reference, Sasha Fronch. Target ONLY the man; exclude the cropped person on the left. Image 2 supplies ONLY the approved warm gouache/colored-pencil medium, actual feline anatomy, contained bust framing and finish. Do not copy image 2's face, thick straight brows, short flat haircut, serious gaze or collared dark shirt.
Primary request: reimagine the man in image 1 as a recognizable anthropomorphic CAT. Preserve his softly oval face, full smiling cheeks, high forehead, gently curved dark brows, relaxed original eye shape and spacing with a subtle happy squint, friendly open smile showing upper teeth, and defined rounded chin. Preserve his full neatly trimmed medium/dark brown beard and connected moustache as darker feline fur around the short muzzle, cheeks, jaw and chin, with a natural rounded beard outline. Keep his friendly relaxed natural adult proportions and smile rather than making him serious, older or excessively angular. Real short natural cat muzzle, small elegant feline nose and fine whiskers; muted warm brown/taupe fur with cream cheek and muzzle highlights.
Hair: thick dark brown loose WAVY/CURLY hair with medium volume on top and natural rounded waves falling toward the forehead, as in image 1. Preserve the distinctive casual wave in the fringe, not a straight close buzz cut, smooth tall quiff or blond hair.
Anatomy: EXACTLY TWO pointed CAT ears TOTAL on TOP of the head, both fully inside canvas with ample clear margin. Eye-level sides must be continuous hair/fur: NO human ears, extra side ears, lower ears or fleshy lobes.
Clothing: fully clothed black wool-like coat/jacket worn OPEN with broad dark lapels over a pale ivory/cream fine-ribbed crewneck knitted shirt/sweater, matching image 1. Preserve the light ribbed central shirt and contrasting black outer garment. No dark button-up shirt, logos or lettering.
Style: detailed warm hand-painted gouache and colored pencil, softly dimensional textured fur, wavy hair, beard, wool and ribbed cotton, warm brown contours and ivory highlights, matching the established portrait series.
Composition: square canvas, ONE centered nearly frontal head-and-upper-torso bust, face toward viewer and natural smiling source expression, relaxed shoulders and rounded lower shoulder silhouette, entire head/hair/ears fully contained with generous transparent margins. No hands or lower body.
Backdrop: genuine transparent alpha. Completely remove the cropped adjacent person, trees, lights, streaks and all dark outdoor scenery. No other people, props, background circle, badge, frame, text or watermark.
